content:
The unique design of the iPhone Duo has prompted Apple to make several adjustments to iOS 27 to fully leverage the strengths of this new phone. These include moving the iPhone dock to the right side of the external display, rather than placing it at the bottom of the screen.

Developer pdfu recently discovered another iPhone Duo-exclusive feature that provides a more convenient way to switch Focus modes……

For the upcoming new hardware, the most conspicuous software adaptation is, of course, that when you open the iPhone Duo, the external display automatically loses focus and becomes transparent. Moving the dock to the right side of the external display is another very obvious and distinctive change for this device.

Developer pdfu has been uncovering and showcasing multiple new features in the iPhone Duo simulator, and has now discovered another one. On the iPhone Duo lock screen, a Focus mode toggle button has been added above the camera and flashlight icons.

It appears this feature only applies when a Focus mode is enabled, making it convenient to turn it off from the lock screen. However, after turning it off, you can also re-enable the same mode. This design is quite practical for situations such as when you have just finished a meeting and want to turn off Do Not Disturb without needing to unlock or open the device.

This leaker has also revealed several other unannounced features, including the StandBy view for the iPhone Duo and HomePad, as well as colour options for the latter.
